# JpegSubsampling

[DotGame.Imaging](README.md) · `DotGame.Imaging.Jpeg` · enum

```csharp
public enum JpegSubsampling
```

How a JPEG image's chroma (its Cb and Cr components) is sampled against its luma, as cjpeg's `-sample` sets it.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="ycbcr420"></a>`YCbCr420` | 4:2:0, cjpeg's default (`-sample 2x2`): chroma at half the width and half the height. |
| <a name="ycbcr422"></a>`YCbCr422` | 4:2:2 (`-sample 2x1`): chroma at half the width. |
| <a name="ycbcr444"></a>`YCbCr444` | 4:4:4 (`-sample 1x1`): chroma at full size. |
